# AITChek.online — AI Agent Readiness & Security Audit Engine for E-Commerce

> AITChek.online is the pioneer AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AI Shopping Agent Readiness Audit Platform. It evaluates e-commerce stores across 64+ critical dimensions to ensure compatibility with autonomous AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, Copilot) while protecting merchants from AI agent fraud and fake COD orders.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **AEO & GEO Optimization**: Audits store visibility, extractable passages, and product recommendations in LLM search engines.
- **AI Crawlers & Robots Policy Audit**: Validates access permissions for GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and Bingbot.
- **Machine-Readable Store Files**: Verifies presence of `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `/pricing.md`, `agent.json`, and `ai-plugin.json`.
- **Structured Schema.org Audit**: Validates JSON-LD for Product, Offer, AggregateRating, Organization, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage schemas.
- **Google PageSpeed Integration**: Live official Google PageSpeed Insights API performance checks.
- **Agent Anti-Fraud & COD Security**: Audits RFC 9421 cryptographic agent signatures, reverse DNS validation, and Cash-on-Delivery (COD) restrictions for automated orders.

## Target E-Commerce Platforms

- Shopify
- Salla (سلة)
- Zid (زد)
- WooCommerce
- Custom Headless & OpenCart Stores

## Public API Endpoints

- `GET /api/health` — Platform engine health check
- `GET /api/audit?url={storeUrl}` — Comprehensive 64-item AI readiness and AEO/GEO audit
- `GET /api/pagespeed?url={storeUrl}` — Live Google PageSpeed Insights audit proxy
